searchText: what is the plan for forkid post-merge? perhaps it will make sense to remove forkid altogether? <@194432762315407360> <@206016661470314496> I think we still want it. There is no forkID for the merge itself, but we will define one retroactively. Forks after the merge will also be scheduled by block number, so the forkID system will work. how do you define one retroactively without breaking the network? I have not considered it yet. We will find a way to do it for sure. Or not. All I know now is, forkID does not work for the merge because it is not scheduled by block number. So I guess the simplest solution will be just skipping the merge in the forkID calculation. That's what happens right now at least. We have a mergeForkBlock, which we will schedule after the merge, basically just an empty fork *we renamed it recently to something else https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/blob/692bfd1bf8f555ab4ccb6b31d6c92cdb5f953db9/params/config.go#L363
